issues.description: [ok] and [fail] tags are not indented with 8 spaces as specified in code-style rule 9. The script uses inline '&&' chaining (e.g., 'ct-ng --version && echo "[ok] --version passed"') instead of separate echo lines with 8-space indentation. This is a minor style deviation that does not affect functionality — the tags are present and correct, just formatted differently from the rule's example pattern.
issues.fix_suggestion: If strict CI output alignment is desired, refactor to separate echo lines: run the command first, check exit code, then echo '        [ok] ...' or '        [fail] ...' with 8-space indentation. However, the current inline pattern is acceptable for test_package scripts.

issues.description: Source URL uses HTTP (http://crosstool-ng.org/download/crosstool-ng/crosstool-ng-1.28.0.tar.bz2) instead of HTTPS. Verified that crosstool-ng.org does NOT support HTTPS — the official website (https://crosstool-ng.github.io/) itself links to HTTP download URLs, and direct HTTPS fetch of crosstool-ng.org failed. This falls under the code-style rule 13 exception: 'URL 禁止用 http://（除非上游不支持 HTTPS）'. The URL points to the official crosstool-ng.org download source (R39 compliant). No GitHub release assets are attached to the crosstool-ng-1.28.0 tag — the tarball is only hosted on crosstool-ng.org.
issues.fix_suggestion: HTTP is acceptable given the upstream exception. If HTTPS is strongly desired, consider using the GitHub tag archive URL (https://github.com/crosstool-ng/crosstool-ng/archive/refs/tags/crosstool-ng-1.28.0.tar.gz) as an alternative, but note that GitHub-generated tarballs may have different directory structure and content from the official release tarball, requiring a different sha256.
